name: Midnight Launch
tagline: A glowing app icon, blur-in type and fanned media cards on near-black — the classic AI launch film.
description: Dark product-launch style for AI tools, APIs and app releases. A gradient app icon focuses in from blur, short "Generate …" lines crossfade through blur while fans of media cards fly out from behind them, a prompt box types itself and a cursor clicks send with a spark, and the film resolves on a centred icon-and-wordmark lockup.
transitions: blur crossfade: out to blur(14px) 0.3s, next line in from blur(18px)
card fans collapse back to centre before the next set flies out
no hard cuts; everything resolves through blur and opacity
textAnimations: prompt types character by character (16ms each)
send click: cursor and button squash, eight rays burst

rhythm.notes: Logo ~1.7s, then three capability beats of ~0.9s each, a ~2s prompt demo and a ~1.5s lockup.

guide:
- Near-black #0a0a0b with a faint purple radial glow at centre; no grids or textures.
- The hero is a rounded-square gradient app icon with a soft coloured shadow. Keep everything centred and symmetrical.
- Capability lines are two words ("Generate images") in Inter 600, swapped with blur crossfades; behind each, a fan of six cards flies out from centre with expo.out and collapses before the next.
- Demonstrate one real action: a prompt box that types a specific request, a cursor that clicks send, and results that de-blur in.
- Use a single warm accent (#ff5b3a) for the send button and highlights only.
- End on icon + wordmark and one muted line saying what it is and where to get it.
